_: plan-11324 S3c (#58435, a3 #3): every tracked file outside src/astryx/orgs.py that ITERATES the cog's registry (orgs.load(…) in python, home.mjs's registry(…) in node, the gateway's cog()), and its role. `resolver`: reads the entries' names, homes and database NAMES only, to refuse or place THIS org; it never opens another org's DSN or key. `cog`: opens every org's DSN and key, and must be one of the design's declared cog-scoped set (gateway, init/apply/parity, observatory). tests/test_cog_scope.py reads the tree: an iterating file not declared here fails (a BUILD FAILURE, the design's words), so does a stale entry, and so does a `cog` file outside the declared set.

src/astryx/config.py.why: _check_pair reads every entry's db NAME to refuse a DSN that binds another org's database (correction 2); it opens nothing

channel/home.mjs.why: registry() validates the file; homeUrl/dsn read homes and db names to place THIS org and refuse another's; it opens nothing

bridges/gateway.py.why: the cog's one door (S3c): one Ctx per org, holding every org's DSN and key (a1 §6: the S6 trip binds here first)
